TeamPage.teamImageAlt: The EGM team in the office: Susanna Weiß, Wolfgang Hansal and Selma Hansal

teamMemberList.name: Mag. Dr. habil. Wolfgang Hansal
teamMemberList.role: Institute Director, Managing Director, Civil Engineer Chemistry, generally sworn and court-certified expert
teamMemberList.description: More than 25 years of professional experience in chemistry, surface technology and electroplating and over 100 industry-relevant projects led. Board member of the European Academy for Surface Technology, very well connected internationally and author of numerous specialist publications – including books on electrochemical pulse plating and on post-processing of 3D-printed metal components (in press).

teamMemberList.name: Mag. Dr. Selma Hansal
teamMemberList.description: Successfully leading industry-relevant R&D projects for more than 20 years, always with a focus on industrial implementation. Core competencies: electrochemistry, materials analysis and post-processing of additively manufactured metal components. Cross-industry networks and aligning entire process chains are a central concern for her.

teamMemberList.name: Ing. Susanna Weiß
teamMemberList.description: Many years of experience in chemical surface treatment and chemical analysis. Besides electrochemistry, specialised in environmental chemistry, surface analysis and hazardous substance management – and a certified expert for safety data sheets according to REACH.

civilEngineers.title: State-authorised. Sworn. Vested with public trust.
paragraphs: State-authorised and sworn civil engineers are natural persons who work freelance in engineering or natural science fields on the basis of an authorisation granted by the Federal Minister for Economic Affairs and Labour. As an outward sign of this state authorisation and oath, they carry a seal bearing the federal coat of arms of the Republic of Austria.

Civil engineers are persons vested with “public trust” pursuant to §292 of the Austrian Code of Civil Procedure (public certifying officers). Within the scope of their authorisation, they are entitled to issue public documents that administrative authorities regard as if they had been issued by the authorities themselves.

Their services range from specialised planning to the overall planning of complex investment projects, as well as testing and consulting as neutral trustees of the client – characterised by transparency, interdisciplinarity, control and accountability.

scientificTeam.title: At the pulse of research.
scientificTeam.description: Keeping pace with technological development is not just our obligation but a very personal concern. We regularly exchange ideas with leading international experts and work closely with them on various projects. Our scientific advisory board supports us with specialist advice when needed and can be involved in innovation projects.
